title: 股价跌5%：现金连赚五季，钱到底从哪来
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Recurites, but a surprise loss for Lyft. The company reported its third quarter earnings yesterday after the bell.
segments.zh: 但Lyft意外亏损。公司昨日盘后公布了第三季度财报。

segments.en: Shares today are falling. The company missed revenue expectations. It posted a quarterly loss. Shares down just a little over 5% right now. Joining us now is Lyft CEO David Rischert.
segments.zh: 今日股价下跌。公司营收未达预期，并录得季度亏损。目前股价下跌略超5%。Lyft CEO David Rischert加入我们。

segments.en: David, thanks so much for joining us on Bloomberg Tech. I want to talk potential MNA because you guys have been on this buying spree over the last couple of years.
segments.zh: David，感谢做客Bloomberg Tech。我想谈谈潜在并购，因为你们过去几年一直在买买买。

segments.en: The European Taxi app free now, TBR Global Show Ferring, get UK, you've been integrating them into the platform, some bike businesses too.
segments.zh: 欧洲出租车应用Free Now、TBR Global、Get UK，你们一直在整合这些平台，还有一些单车业务。

segments.en: What is your appetite for further MNA over the next year or two?
segments.zh: 未来一两年，你们对进一步并购的兴趣如何？

segments.en: So we're in a nice position right now and here's why. We have a very strong core business.
segments.zh: 我们目前处境不错，原因如下：核心业务非常强劲。

segments.en: Bookings are up 17% year on year as you just mentioned active riders. It's sort of I don't know how many quarters of all time active high riders we've had, including by the way, even on Halloween a couple of days ago.
segments.zh: 预订量同比增长17%，正如你提到的活跃乘客数，我们已连续多个季度创历史新高，包括几天前的万圣节。

segments.en: Again, new all time high. So that's a very good core business. It produces about $1.1 billion of cash trailing 12 months, so that five quarters in a row.
segments.zh: 再次创下历史新高。所以核心业务非常健康，过去12个月产生约11亿美元现金，连续五个季度如此。

segments.en: So that unlocks opportunities for growth. And as you said, we've purchased a couple of European assets because we were primarily a US company.
segments.zh: 这为增长创造了机会。如你所说，我们收购了几项欧洲资产，因为之前我们主要是美国公司。

segments.en: Now we're a much more global company. And so today, for example, a year after that acquisition, if you're a Lyft rider you can open up your phone in London or Paris or Barcelona or Amsterdam and you can get a Lyft ride.
segments.zh: 现在我们更加全球化。例如今天，收购一年后，Lyft乘客可以在伦敦、巴黎、巴塞罗那或阿姆斯特丹打开手机叫Lyft。

segments.en: So that's an amazing place to be. I don't want to speculate so much about future acquisition. We've got a lot on our plate right now just to integrate the current ones we've already got.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个很好的位置。我不想过多猜测未来的收购。我们现在手头有很多事情要做，只是为了整合我们已经拥有的当前业务。
